_readme: DEMO DATASET — NOT A LIVE REGISTRY FEED.
BIS does not publish a key-free public licence lookup, so this MVP ships a small sample
file. Every entry below is an ILLUSTRATIVE demo record: the build sandbox had no network
access to the BIS portal, so no number here could be confirmed, and this file makes no
claim about which product or Indian Standard any number relates to.
The app therefore only reports two things it can honestly report:
a) whether a BIS / ISI / CM-L licence mark is DECLARED at all in the label text
(a presence check on the OCR output — no external claim), and
b) whether that declared number appears in this demo file.
A number that is not in the file returns 'not in demo dataset — cannot verify'. It is
never reported as invalid. Absence of an ISI mark is also not automatically a Legal
Metrology violation (ISI marking is compulsory only for goods under BIS CM/L orders),
so this check is always reported as advisory and never as a legal failure.
source: Demo dataset — production version integrates live BIS portal lookup
